query: Customer onboarding notices omit retention periods and complaint channels for data subjects.
Deletion requests are processed manually and retention exceptions are undocumented.
The privacy program has technical safeguards but no periodic review of organizational measures.
Processor agreements do not require deletion support or sub-processor restrictions at termination.
Business units keep separate spreadsheets and there is no central record of processing activities.
Incident procedures do not define when the supervisory authority must be notified after a breach.
Tax filings are completed monthly but the team cannot show reviewer sign-off for submissions.
Support for tax positions is scattered in shared drives and hard to retrieve for audit.
Manual journal entries affecting statutory reporting do not require secondary approval evidence.
Payroll and filing agents are onboarded once and never reviewed again for control effectiveness.
No single owner tracks jurisdictional tax rule changes or regulatory updates.
Statutory reporting systems lack a tested fallback process for filing deadlines.
